subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

 The Prime Minister will __address the nation__ tomorrow.

options.text: A postal code for sending letters

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"address"** in the context of the sentence means to deliver a speech or communicate formally with an audience. (भाषण देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The CEO will address the employees during the annual meeting to discuss future plans.
 
 
 
• 
 
• Example:** The Prime Minister will address the concerns of the citizens regarding policy changes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To greet people** (लोगों का अभिवादन करना): Refers to welcoming or acknowledging people.

 
 
• **Example:** He greeted everyone warmly at the party.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: A postal code for sending letters** (पत्रों को भेजने के लिए एक डाक कोड): Refers to a unique code used for mail delivery.
 
 
• **Example:** Make sure to include the postal code when addressing the envelope.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A landmark** (एक प्रसिद्ध स्थान): Refers to a significant or recognizable physical location.
 
 
• **Example:** The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
